purpose: Fresh FRANKENSTEIN-ready proposals from Apr 14-20 arXiv/GitHub sweep — feed directly to FRANKENSTEIN before clean TF restart.
ranking_rule: expected_impact ÷ implementation_days, tie-break by blast_radius (how many TFs benefit)

proposals.title: Replace MANDATORY-pact prompt with Coalition-of-Thought (CoalT) from Guo et al. 2604.14386
proposals.hypothesis: Our post-fix coalition rate is ~20-30%. CoalT reached 73.2% Nash-stable partitions across GPT-4/Claude-3/Llama-3. Swapping the prompt template should close the gap.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: Lockstep Jaccard 0.94 → 0.65; POL+NBA fleet drawdown -25%; Brier -0.002 fleet-average.
proposals.kill_criterion: If Nash-stable partition rate (measured by our audit) stays <50% after 10 days, revert.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN → edit _build_prompt in hf-llm-trading-floor/app.py + hf-political-trading-floor/app.py + pqtf + itf

proposals.title: Replace heuristic MIN_DEPLOY tiers with formal Risk-Constrained Kelly 1-D calibration (Long 2604.11577)
proposals.hypothesis: Today's dynamic MIN_DEPLOY (0.75→0.25 by drawdown) is a heuristic. The paper proves for log-utility that drawdown-constrained Kelly has an exact 1-D calibration with SAME active set as unconstrained. Solving it is a scipy.optimize.brentq call.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: PQTF/ITF/NBA max-drawdown -30% at same growth rate (from theory); Sharpe +0.3.
proposals.kill_criterion: If replaced sizer produces lower Sharpe than heuristic over 14 paper-trade days, revert.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN → new file scripts/arena/kelly_sizer.py + wire into all 4 TFs' stake_sizer function

proposals.title: Audit all islands; swap isotonic → Venn-Abers / Beta on CatBoost/XGBoost/LightGBM (Manokhin 2601.19944)
proposals.hypothesis: S22 already wins with Venn-Abers (0.22073). Paper shows isotonic SYSTEMATICALLY DEGRADES proper scoring on strong tabular models — which describes S13/S14/S15/S17/S18. Sweeping fleet should compound S22's 0.22073 advantage.
proposals.kill_criterion: If any swapped island loses >0.003 Brier in 48h walk-forward, revert that island only.
proposals.targets_agent: SWISH (NBA) + LOBBYIST (POL) → modify init/mutate/crossover calibrator step, roll out one island at a time

proposals.title: Port PolySwarm's KL/JS divergence cross-market inefficiency engine as lockstep/inefficiency signal
proposals.hypothesis: PolySwarm uses KL(p_a||p_b) between agent beliefs to detect latency arb AND flag groupthink. We can piggyback same signal to (a) dynamically downweight agents whose belief-distributions have KL<ε from the rest (true lockstep measure) and (b) emit alerts when inefficiency exceeds threshold.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: POL+NBA: -0.003 Brier from proper lockstep detection; bonus: reusable in PM-TF later.
proposals.kill_criterion: If KL-based agent downweighting hurts fleet Brier in paper trade, revert.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN → new scripts/arena/belief_divergence.py, wire into INTERNAL AFFAIRS audit + TF post-filter

proposals.title: Run our 17-agent fleet through PolyBench benchmark as external calibration check before PM-TF launch
proposals.hypothesis: PolyBench already has 38,666 Polymarket markets with CLOB-realistic execution sim. Running our fleet produces a ranking card vs MiMo-V2-Flash (17.6% CWR) / Gemini-3-Flash (6.2%). If we rank below all 7 baselines, DO NOT launch PM-TF.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: De-risk PM-TF launch; produces an objective external calibration reference.
proposals.kill_criterion: If fleet scores below all 7 PolyBench models on CWR, shelve PM-TF proposal entirely.
proposals.targets_agent: HAWKEYE + DR FRANKENSTEIN → clone PolyBench repo, run as one-shot experiment, commit results

proposals.title: Upgrade coalition_proposal schema to binding contracts with conditional payments (Tewolde/Conitzer/Jin 2604.15267)
proposals.hypothesis: CoopEval shows LLMs consistently defect in single-shot dilemmas — reputation alone is insufficient. Binding contracts with conditional payments (auto-executing stake transfers on tripwire) were the most effective cooperation mechanism.
proposals.kill_criterion: If binding-contract pacts have <30% execution rate after 14 days, revert.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN → extend coalition_proposal schema with trigger/transfer fields, add evaluator cron

proposals.title: Upgrade prompt_mutator.py to Adaptive-OPRO with stochastic PnL reward (Papadakis et al. 2510.15949)
proposals.hypothesis: Our prompt_mutator uses binary post-mortem flags. ATLAS shows Adaptive-OPRO with stochastic real-time feedback consistently outperforms fixed prompts AND reflection-based feedback. Switch to realized-PnL gradient.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: TF agents: +8-12% cumulative return over 30 days (half of paper's SPY claim = conservative).
proposals.kill_criterion: If ACL-cited improvement not reproduced in 30d paper trade, revert.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN → scripts/arena/prompt_mutator.py upgrade + OPRO stochastic scoring loop

proposals.title: Inject WHO-WHOM-WHAT causal frame into GammaOptions persona (Regan/Xie 2512.17923)
proposals.hypothesis: LLMs hit 71.5% GEX pattern detection with WHO-WHOM-WHAT framing (economic actor / affected party / mechanism). Our GammaOptions (mistral:large) would benefit. Caveat: detection ≠ profitability — keep PnL gate.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: ITF options leg: better structured reasoning, uncertain PnL delta.
proposals.kill_criterion: If GammaOptions 0DTE PnL goes negative over 10 trading days, disable.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN → edit GammaOptions system_prompt in itf/personas.py

proposals.title: Add regime-boundary detector (VIX>25 or FRED macro-surprise>1σ) with price-only fallback (Yang 2604.10996)
proposals.hypothesis: LLM-extracted features valid in calm regimes (IC>0.15) but ADD NOISE during macro stress. Need a regime detector that collapses to price-only ensemble when tripped.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: Drawdown -20% during macro-stress periods; preservation, not alpha.
proposals.kill_criterion: If regime detector trips >30% of trading days, recalibrate or remove.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN → scripts/arena/regime_detector.py, wire into all 4 TFs' morning cycle

proposals.title: Cherry-pick TauricResearch/TradingAgents debate/consensus mechanism to upgrade morning council
proposals.hypothesis: Our morning council = single-shot qwen-235B moderator. TradingAgents' LangGraph-based debate passes proposals through analyst→researcher→trader→risk with structured rounds. Should yield tighter proposals than single-shot moderation.
proposals.impact_brier_or_pnl: Morning-council output quality +20% (soft metric); downstream Brier -0.001.
proposals.kill_criterion: If morning-council round-trip time > 3× baseline or Brier unchanged after 21 days, revert.
proposals.targets_agent: DR FRANKENSTEIN (big job; consider splitting) → add scripts/arena/council_debate.py with LangGraph mirror

summary.pm_tf_gate: Do not launch PM-TF (5th floor) until P05 PolyBench ranking confirms fleet beats at least 2 of 7 baselines.
